description: CODE-3 (writing is reading reversed): the WRITE-side twin of seeds/code_constructions.json. Each ShapeSignature{kind:'code_write_construction'} carries a ONE-token trigger (a single content word mechanically extracted from an NL function-writing request -- domains/code_writing.py._content_tokens, the write-side analogue of code_reading.py._root_marker: fixed text prep, not a decision) as its signature, plus a ground_template holding a Term-tree RECIPE (placeholder Var names a/b/items -- the function's eventual argument names), an ordered args list, and an English desc used verbatim as the written function's docstring lead sentence. compose_function_from_request decodes the request's content-word skeleton against this codebook via the SAME Rust ShapeDecode Term reflective_faculty.compose_design_for_goal already runs for code READING and English-clause reading -- the construction with the best shape_fit wins; a request with no positive-fit construction honestly abstains ('I don't hold a shape for that yet'), never approximated. A SMALL starter vocabulary (larger/smaller/sum/product/absolute-value/average of two numbers; total/count over a list) -- growing it is CODE-4's.

microtheory.name: code_write_constructions
microtheory.description: writing a function from an NL request is ShapeDecode over a request-construction codebook, symmetric with code_constructions' read side
